title: The condition operators `In` / `NotIn` are deprecated — Kyverno warns at admission (only invalid operators are refused)

detection.reason: condition operators inside rules are not collected

quote: Policies using long-deprecated or invalid operators in conditions (ex., `In` and `NotIn`) will be blocked.
remediation: Replace `In` with `AnyIn`/`AllIn` and `NotIn` with `AnyNotIn`/`AllNotIn` in preconditions and deny conditions. Through 1.20 they still work: #8624 returns a deprecation warning for them (validate.go `checkDeprecatedOperator`) and refuses only operators that are not valid at all.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterpolicies.kyverno.io,policies.kyverno.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select([.. | objects | select(has("key")) | .operator? // empty] | any(. == "In" or . == "NotIn")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row uses In or NotIn in a condition (label-selector matchExpressions are not counted)
coversNotes: v1.12.0 Helm: #8624 feat: add fail/warn on deprecated/invalid operators

title: `--imageSignatureRepository` is removed — the controller refuses to start with it

detection.reason: checked in the container args of the Kyverno Deployments (admission and background controllers) — a flag passed any other way is not scanned

quote: The `--imageSignatureRepository` flag is deprecated and has no effect, use the `verifyImages.Repository` field instead (#9698)
remediation: Remove `--imageSignatureRepository` from the Kyverno containers' args (Helm extraArgs) and set `repository` on the verifyImages rules instead. 1.12 no longer defines the flag (cmd/internal/flag.go@v1.12.0), so a container passing it exits at start.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]; .image | test("(^|/)kyverno/(kyverno|background-controller|cleanup-controller|reports-controller)([:@]|$)"))) | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[].args[]?; test("^--?imageSignatureRepository(=|$)"))) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row passes the removed flag
coversNotes: v1.12.0 Helm: #9698 fix: remove deprecated imageSignatureRepository flag

title: `--omit-events` is renamed `--omitEvents` — a controller passed the old name refuses to start

detection.reason: checked in the container args of the Kyverno Deployments (admission, background and reports controllers) — a flag passed any other way is not scanned

remediation: Rename `--omit-events` to `--omitEvents` in the Kyverno containers' extra args (v1.11.5 cmd/kyverno/main.go:223 vs v1.12.0:264, same in the background and reports controllers). The chart renders the new name from `features.omitEvents` itself; only extraArgs or kustomize patches carry the old one.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]; .image | test("(^|/)kyverno/(kyverno|background-controller|cleanup-controller|reports-controller)([:@]|$)"))) | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[].args[]?; test("^--?omit-events(=|$)"))) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row passes the old flag name

title: `spec.schemaValidation` is deprecated and has no effect

detection.reason: read from whether each policy sets spec.schemaValidation

quote: The `spec.schemaValidation` field is formally deprecated. As of 1.11 it has no effect. (#9189)
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterpolicies.kyverno.io,policies.kyverno.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.schemaValidation != null) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row sets schemaValidation

title: kyverno.io/v2alpha1 PolicyException (and CleanupPolicy) is no longer served

detection.reason: the apiVersion a manifest was written in is not collected

scope.reason: read from each named CRD's status.storedVersions (version names only)

quote: #9211 chore: remove v2alpha1 version of policy exceptions
remediation: Rewrite every manifest (Git, Helm charts) that uses `kyverno.io/v2alpha1` for PolicyException, CleanupPolicy or ClusterCleanupPolicy to `kyverno.io/v2beta1`; the API server refuses the old version once 1.12's CRDs are applied.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.group | test("^kyverno\\.io$")) | "\(.metadata.name) served=\([.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] | join(",")) stored=\(.status.storedVersions | join(","))"'  # each row is a kyverno.io CRD; a stored or served v2alpha1 means objects were written in it

title: Webhooks now exclude kube-system by default — policies stop applying there

detection.reason: Kyverno's rendered webhook namespaceSelector is rewritten by Kyverno at runtime

remediation: The 1.12 chart excludes `kube-system` from every Kyverno webhook (values.yaml `config.webhooks`), so policies you enforced there stop applying. Override `config.webhooks` if kube-system must stay covered.
verifyCommand: kubectl get validatingwebhookconfigurations,mutatingwebhookconfigurations -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("kyverno")) | .metadata.name as $n | .webhooks[]? | "\($n) \(.name) \(.namespaceSelector | tostring)"'  # each row is a Kyverno webhook and the namespaces it selects

title: The chart's ClusterRoles no longer use wildcards

detection.reason: Kyverno's effective RBAC is not collected

remediation: If generate or mutate-existing rules act on resources outside the chart's list, grant them through `*.rbac.clusterRole.extraResources` before upgrading.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterpolicies.kyverno.io,policies.kyverno.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.rules[]?; has("generate"))) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row has a generate rule that needs explicit RBAC on its targets
coversNotes: v1.12.0 Helm: #9507 feat: add more granular rbac rules to

title: Kyverno validates ValidatingAdmissionPolicy CEL expressions and may block invalid ones
quote: Kyverno will validate ValidatingAdmissionPolicies' CEL expressions and show a warning, or block, if invalid (#9566)
remediation: Fix any ValidatingAdmissionPolicy whose CEL expressions do not compile; Kyverno may refuse it on the next update.
verifyCommand: kubectl get validatingadmissionpolicies -o name 2>/dev/null  # each row is a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy Kyverno will validate
